scope: Gomoku computer only. One ordinary prime excluded from all baseline metrics; then alternating HTTP-memory/disk-cache removal and natural HTTP-cache fresh-WK trials in one exact guest profile. Cache setup and prior animated dismissal/release are recorded separately before open. Each measured endpoint retains open-to-public-DOM native receipt; controls are not Worker proof, actual black is input acceptance, computer white includes gameplay think delay. No native-ready signal, prefetch/prepare/keeper, gameplay/storage/identity reset between trials, cookie/LS/IDB deletion, OS-cold claim or comparison to current 9ba loopback. Old default orientation/animations retained per observation. Failures and incomplete rows excluded from successful counts; all raw observations retained.
